# Spring-NWVMC (`0.1.0`) — Documentation Index for LLMs & AI Agents

> Enterprise declarative REST, GraphQL, persistence, RBAC/ABAC security, resilience, and observability starter (*Next-Wave Virtual Multi-Controller*) for **Java 21 LTS** and **Spring Boot 3.x** (`io.github.natswarchuan:spring-nwvmc:0.1.0` on Maven Central; optional JitPack mirror: `com.github.NatswarChuan:Spring-NWVMC:v0.1.0`).

## Critical Anti-Hallucination & SDD/TDD Facts (Read First)

- **SDD + TDD Mandatory:** Draft `specs/<feature>/spec.md` (`REQ-ID` Given/When/Then), stop on `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]`, build `plan.md` + `tasks.md`, execute **RED → GREEN → REFACTOR** across 4 test tiers with zero `@Disabled`.
- **Artifact & Build:** Maven Central `io.github.natswarchuan:spring-nwvmc:0.1.0` (no `v` prefix) + Java 21 + `<parameters>true</parameters>` in `maven-compiler-plugin`.
- **9 Real Composable Interfaces (40 routes):** `AutoReadApi` (5), `AutoKeysetApi` (1), `AutoAnalyticsApi` (4), `AutoSchemaApi` (5), `AutoWriteApi` (6), `AutoBatchApi` (4), `AutoExportImportApi` (4), `AutoWorkflowApi` (9), `AutoAiApi` (2). NEVER invent `AutoAuditApi` or `AutoStateApi`.
- **13 Real Filter Operators (`FilterOperatorConstant`):** `.eq`, `.ne`, `.like`, `.startsWith`, `.endsWith`, `.gt`, `.gte`, `.lt`, `.lte`, `.in`, `.notIn`, `.between`, `.null` (NEVER `__gte`, `.neq`, `.ilike`, `.isNull`, `.isNotNull`).
- **Runtime & Security Guardrails:** Extend `BaseAuditEntity` (NEVER `@Data`, NEVER `@SoftDelete`); `@StateMachine` colon syntax `"FROM:TO1,TO2"` + `?targetState=` (illegal jumps return `422`); inject framework `@AutoComponent` helpers via `ObjectProvider<T>`; non-final `@Lazy @Service` + lazy injection (`0.1.0` supports method-level `@TargetDataSource` natively); use `HttpHeaderConstant.HEADER_X_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY` for `"X-Idempotency-Key"`; dev JWT is `POST /api/v1/auth/token?username=admin&role=ROLE_ADMIN` and `JwtTokenService.generateToken(username, userId, roles)`; harden prod (`studio.enabled=false`, `default-deny-unannotated-entities=true`, `require-authenticated-api-paths=true`, `JWT_SECRET >= 32` B, Springdoc off, `ddl-auto=validate`).

## Quick Adoption Kit Links (Canonical HTTPS — GitHub Pages Safe)

- [AI-Agent Adoption Kit README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatswarChuan/Spring-NWVMC-document/main/ai-agent-kit/README.md): English onboarding guide, compatibility matrix for every AI coding tool and LLM, hardened zero-clone 1-command installers (`install.ps1` / `install.sh`), and starter prompts.
- [INTRO](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatswarChuan/Spring-NWVMC-document/main/ai-agent-kit/INTRO.md): Architecture, Maven Central `0.1.0` setup, 2-Directory Contract, 9 composable API interfaces, 6 built-in platform endpoint groups.
- [RULES](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatswarChuan/Spring-NWVMC-document/main/ai-agent-kit/RULES.md): Mandatory SDD/TDD protocol, strict anti-hallucination & AppSec guardrails (`< 24 KB`).
- [SKILL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatswarChuan/Spring-NWVMC-document/main/ai-agent-kit/SKILL.md): Progressive-disclosure `spring-nwvmc-adoption` runbook (**7 workflows** `0`–`6` + **15-row** troubleshooting matrix).
- [CHECKLIST](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatswarChuan/Spring-NWVMC-document/main/ai-agent-kit/CHECKLIST.md): **7-phase** (Phase 0–6) SDD, Pre-Flight, Design, Runtime Gotchas, Production Security Lockdown, Multi-Pod Performance & TDD Go-Live checklist.
- [60 Annotations & 133 Attributes Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatswarChuan/Spring-NWVMC-document/main/ai-agent-kit/references/01-annotations-exact-matrix.md)
- [40 Auto-Endpoints & 13 Query Operators](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatswarChuan/Spring-NWVMC-document/main/ai-agent-kit/references/02-endpoints-and-query-dsl.md)
